About

Jay Cue Construction is an award winning family owned remodeling firm that has been delivering “Quality and Dependability” since 1976.

The president of the company John Quaregna, CR. established the company in 1976 in North Bergen, NJ. Jay Cue Construction is a fully licensed and insured residential and commercial remodeling company specializing in renovations, additions, roofing, remodeling, siding, and all types of repairs.

Experience & Knowledge

As a General Contractor, Jay Cue Construction has the experience and knowledge to work with a broad range of clients on virtually any construction project. We have a wide variety of Residential, Commercial & Municipal clients such as; large corporate clients, small businesses, homeowners, libraries, churches, malls, strip malls, and hotels.

We provide the highest quality of work and customer service with satisfaction guaranteed. Jay Cue is known for quality work and excellent follow up services for years after a job is completed.

We have 6 trucks that are fully loaded with state of the art tools and equipment for a professional job each and every time. All our employees are trained in house and follow a strict safety plan. Additionally, we are a NARI certified remodeler.

If you have any question to help coordinate or assist you with your next project, please call our office today!
